title: Quaternion Slerp
hints: d = a·b (4D dot of coeffs). If d < 0, negate b: q and −q are the same rotation, and this picks the shortest path.
Ω = acos(d). Result = (sin((1−t)Ω) a + sin(tΩ) b) / sin Ω.
When d ≈ 1, sin Ω ≈ 0. Fall back to nlerp: normalize((1−t) a + t b). Clamp d to ≤ 1 before acos.
